svg.title: How changing the base fee changes predicted delivery fees and errors
svg.desc: The additional distances x are [0, 1, 2] km, and the fee per km w stays fixed at 1 thousand KRW. Changing the base fee b from 0 to 0.1 thousand KRW changes predicted fees, calculated as b + w × x, from [0, 1, 2] to [0.1, 1.1, 2.1] thousand KRW. The targets y are the actual delivery fees, which stay unchanged at [1, 3, 5] thousand KRW. Errors, calculated as predicted fee minus actual fee, change from [-1, -2, -3] to [-0.9, -1.9, -2.9]. Each predicted fee rises by 0.1 thousand KRW, so subtracting the same actual fee increases each error by the same amount.

g.aria-label: Each predicted fee rises by 0.1 thousand KRW.
g.title: Each predicted fee rises by 0.1 thousand KRW.

g.aria-label: Each error rises by the same amount.
